Figure 2: The three experimental arms as rendered to users. Arms 1 and 2 are pixel-identical to the user (the algorithm sees different metadata); Arm 3 replaces the body text with the explicit women-targeted fragment. The contrast between Arms 1 and 2 isolates the algorithmic targeting channel; the contrast between Arms 2 and 3 isolates the user-visible creative channel.
